name: Breakable Integrals
definition: A family of integral functions defined over $[t_1, t_{N+1}]$ that can be rewritten as a sum of products of integrals over individual segments $[t_k, t_{k+1}]$, enabling distribution across multiple GPUs.
summary: Breakable integrals decompose volume rendering equations into segment-wise operations for efficient multi-GPU parallelization, distinguishing themselves by distributing the integral's mathematical structure rather than just data elements.
